browser: Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.4, Playwright headless Chromium default launch, DPR 1
method: Fresh pages, local live API, same browser launch configuration. Real-time requestAnimationFrame timestamps and long-task observer; no screenshots or concurrent test/capture jobs during sampling. 1440x900: four route pairs, two repeats at 1x and 4x CPU rate. Other desktop sizes: four pairs, one repeat at 1x.

interpretation.startupDOMReplacements: Successful samples record two endpoint source-to-bitmap replacements at the travelling phase commit, before the first painted travel frame. Frozen images then remain immutable (browser regression assertion).

stress.note: At 4x CPU throttling, some long journeys exceed the existing 1800ms raster-preparation guard and use the original CSS/live-glass fallback. That fallback remains functional but is not 60fps in this software-rendered run. Guard/phase/animation logic was intentionally retained.
